title: vicia americana var. oregana
intro: Vicia americana var. oregana, commonly known as American vetch, is a type of leguminous plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). American vetch is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to support cardiovascular health and lower cholesterol levels due to its high content of fiber and omega-3 fatty acids. The therapeutic actions of American vetch include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of American vetch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
